# MarkdownEditor > Compose Markdown with draggable blocks, slash commands, people mentions, formatting, and application-owned image uploads. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `markdown-editor` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown-editor.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown-editor.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@tiptap/core@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/extension-image@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/extension-list@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/extension-paragraph@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/extension-table@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/markdown@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/pm@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/react@3.31.4` - `@tiptap/starter-kit@3.31.4` - `lucide-react@^1.47.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `chat-composer-attachment` - `checkbox` - `core` - `dropdown-menu` - `input` - `label` - `live-status` - `popover` - `scroll-area` - `textarea` - `toolbar` - `tooltip` - `trigger-menu` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/markdown-editor-knobs`: `markdownEditorKnobs`, types `MarkdownEditorKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor`: `MarkdownEditor`, `MarkdownEditorContent`, types `MarkdownEditorStatus`, `MarkdownEditorProps`, `MarkdownEditorContentProps` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/bubble-menu`: `MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/context`: `defaultMarkdownEditorLabels`, `MarkdownEditorContext`, `useMarkdownEditor`, types `MarkdownEditorLabels`, `MarkdownEditorContextValue` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/drag-handle`: `MarkdownEditorDragHandle` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/drag-preview`: `createDragPreview`, types `DragPreview` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/extensions`: `isEditorUrl`, `persistentUrlPolicy`, `ImageUpload`, `markdownExtensions`, `createMarkdownCodec`, `requiresMarkdownSource`, `hasMarkdownContent`, types `MarkdownUrlKind`, `MarkdownUrlPolicy`, `MarkdownExtensionOptions` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/suggestions`: `MarkdownEditorSuggestions`, types `MarkdownEditorMention`, `MarkdownEditorSuggestionsProps` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/table-commands`: `firstMovable`, `lineCount`, `canMoveLine`, `selectLine`, `moveLine`, `runInCell`, `alignColumn`, types `ColumnAlign` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/table-controls`: `MarkdownEditorTableControls` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/table-geometry`: `tableTargetFrom`, `tableTargetAt`, `tableAt`, `cellStart`, `tableElement`, `measureTable`, `nearestGap`, `indexForGap`, `isNear`, `toSurface`, types `TableAxis`, `TableTarget`, `SurfaceBox`, `TableLayout` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/table-grip`: `TableGrip` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/task-item`: `MarkdownTaskItem` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/toolbar`: `useMarkdownEditorFormatActions`, `MarkdownEditorFormatButton`, `MarkdownEditorToolbar`, `MarkdownEditorHeading`, `MarkdownEditorLink`, `MarkdownEditorImage`, `MarkdownEditorUploads` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/uploads`: `findImageUpload`, `completeImageUpload`, `markdownImageTypes`, types `MarkdownImage`, `MarkdownImageUploader`, `MarkdownImageUpload` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/use-image-uploads`: `useImageUploads` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/use-table-target`: `useTableTarget` ## Composition ### Markdown composition Markdown strings stay application-owned. Content includes block drag handles (Alt+ArrowUp/ArrowDown also moves blocks). Suggestions adds slash commands and accepts people with persistent profile URLs; mentions save as Markdown links. Supply onUploadImage to enable image paste and drop. Pass extensions to add TipTap extensions after the built-in Markdown set, and isUrlAllowed to change which link and image URLs stay editable (a file-based editor can accept relative links); both are read once, when the editor mounts. ```tsx ``` ### Selection bubble menu Use MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu instead of, or alongside, MarkdownEditorToolbar. It appears above non-empty text selections outside code blocks and reuses the toolbar's text style, mark, and link controls; pass children to append custom controls. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useId, useState } from "react"; import { MarkdownEditor, MarkdownEditorContent } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor"; import { MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/bubble-menu"; import { MarkdownEditorSuggestions } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/suggestions"; import { MarkdownEditorToolbar, MarkdownEditorUploads } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/toolbar"; import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label"; import { Markdown } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/markdown"; import { Switch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/switch"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const people = [ { id: "alex", label: "Alex Morgan", href: "/people/alex", description: "Design" }, { id: "sam", label: "Sam Rivera", href: "/people/sam", description: "Engineering" }, { id: "jordan", label: "Jordan Lee", href: "/people/jordan", description: "Product" }, ]; const initialMarkdown = "## Project feedback\n\nWe need **clearer feedback** on the new dashboard.\n\n- [x] Describe the issue\n- [ ] Add a screenshot\n\n> Keep the next step easy to find."; export function MarkdownEditorExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); return (
Type / for blocks or @ to mention someone. Drag the handle beside a block to reorder it.
); } export function MarkdownEditorBubbleMenuExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); return (
Select text to format it, type / for blocks, or @ to mention someone.
); } export function MarkdownEditorReadOnlyExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); const [locked, setLocked] = useState(true); const lockId = useId(); return (
{locked ? "Read-only content stays selectable and focusable, so it can be copied and read by assistive technology." : "Unlocked. Edit the description, then lock it again."}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `markdown-editor` - `bubble-menu` - `content` - `root`: `data-disabled`, `data-readonly` - `source` - `suggestion-description` - `table-controls` - `table-drop-line`: `data-axis` (`column` | `row`) - `task-checkbox` - `task-content` - `task-item` - `toolbar` - `uploads` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### markdown-editor - `--cui-markdown-editor-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-focus-border-color`: `var(--focus-rim)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gutter-size`: `var(--control-h-xs)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-min-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 32)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-max-height`: `60dvh` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-muted-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-code-background`: `var(--muted)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-selection-background`: `var(--active-fill)` ### label - `--cui-label-root-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/markdown-editor - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/markdown-editor.json
